# FILL THIS IN YOURSELF from the GEO series page:
#   https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE152495
# and cross-check against Supplemental Table S2 of paper.pdf.
# The GSM accession numbers below are PLACEHOLDERS — replace them with the
# real ones you read off the GEO page. Sample names must match exactly the
# Sex_Treatment_Replicate pattern; script 01 validates them and will stop
# if they do not.
# Verifying the mapping is not busywork: a swapped label produces a pipeline
# that runs cleanly and answers the wrong question.
# Sanity check after loading: female samples should show high roX1/roX2
# (male-specific lncRNAs are LOW in females — the paper reports roX2 among
# its cocaine-responsive genes precisely because it is sex-linked). If your
# "Female" samples are roX2-high, your mapping is inverted.
